modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cobblehun: Records your battles against special wild Pokémon (shiny, legendary, mythical and ultra beasts) to text files, with an optional shiny hunt counter and HUD.
cobblehuntlog.config.record_mode.special: Only shiny, legendary, mythical and ultra beasts.
cobblehuntlog.config.record_mode.all.too: Any battle against a wild Pokémon.
cobblehuntlog.config.shiny_rate.tooltip: The server's shiny rate. Cobblemon's default is 8192.
cobblehuntlog.config.lock_species.toolti: Click: lock the species of your last wild battle and count only that one. Click again to unlock.
cobblehuntlog.shiny.toast.title: Shiny %s!
cobblehuntlog.shiny.chat: [Cobble Hunt Log] Shiny %s after %s encounters and %s of hunting! Saved to history; the counter resets to 0.
cobblehuntlog.history.title: Shiny history
cobblehuntlog.history.empty: No shinies yet. Good luck hunting!
cobblehuntlog.config.edit_hud.tooltip: Drag the HUD wherever you want and change its size with the mouse wheel.
cobblehuntlog.edit.title: Move and resize HUD
cobblehuntlog.edit.help: Drag to move · Wheel: size · Arrows: fine-tune (Shift = 10)
